src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Which among the following are incorrectly paired with regard to Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023?

I. Best SafaiMitra Suraksha Sheher: Prayagraj

II. Cleanest Ganga Town rank 2: Varanasi

III. Cleanest Cantonment Board: Mhow Cantonment Board

IV. All India Cleanest City rank 3: Navi Mumbai
x: In Swachh Survekshan 2023, Mhow was the cleanest cantonment and Navi Mumbai was 3rd, so III and IV are correct pairs. Varanasi was the best Ganga town (not rank 2), so II is wrong. Prayagraj was not the Safaimitra Surakshit Shehar winner, so I is wrong. Hence I and II are incorrectly paired.

src: APPSC Group-I Paper-II Screening Test 2019
s: According to UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report (TDR) 2017, one of the following statements is not correct:
o: The world economy in 2017 is picking up but not lifting off.
The global growth is expected to reach 2.6%, well below pre 2008 financial crisis average of 3.2%.
At current levels of growth, both India and China will not serve as 'growth poles' for global economy in near future.
India and China at their current levels of growth, they will become 'growth poles' for global economy in near future.
x: TDR 2017 said the world economy was 'picking up but not lifting off', with ~2.6% growth against the pre-crisis 3.2% average, and that at current growth rates China and India were unlikely to act as global growth poles – so statement (d), that they will become growth poles, is the incorrect one.

s: Which of the following religions has the largest global following across the world?
x: Christianity has the largest following: about 2.3 billion people, 28.8% of the world in 2020 (Pew Research Center, June 2025). Islam (about 25.6%) is the fastest-growing religion but still second; Hinduism is third among religions and Buddhism fourth.

src: APPSC Deputy Educational Officer Screening Test General Stud
s: As per National Population and Housing Census 2021 of Nepal, what percentage of birth of children of age 5 years and below was NOT registered in Nepal?
x: Nepal's National Population and Housing Census 2021 found that births of only about 74% of children below five years had been registered by their parents or guardians, so about 26% were NOT registered. 36%, 46% and 56% overstate the gap (UNICEF's separate MICS survey gives about 77% registered, which is a survey figure, not the census).
